title: Independent Contractor - SAP Master Data Governance (MDG)
description:
Date: Sep 10, 2026
Job Requisition Id: 66258
Location:
Hyderabad, TG, IN
YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.

  

At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting\-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.

  

**We are looking forward to hire SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) Professionals in the following areas :**

  

**Job Summary**


We are seeking an experienced and customer\-focused **SAP MDG Solution Architect** with **15\+ years of SAP experience**, including extensive expertise in **SAP Master Data Governance (MDG)** across both functional and technical domains. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving MDG strategy, architecting enterprise\-scale master data solutions, engaging directly with customers, leading delivery teams, and ensuring successful implementation of SAP MDG programs.


This role requires a strong blend of solution architecture, consulting, stakeholder management, team leadership, and hands\-on SAP MDG expertise covering **Central Governance, Consolidation, Mass Processing, Data Quality Management, and Integration frameworks**.


**Key Responsibilities**


* **Solution Architecture \& Design**
	+ Define and own end\-to\-end SAP MDG solution architecture aligned with customer business objectives and enterprise data strategies.
	+ Lead discovery sessions, workshops, and solution design discussions with business and IT stakeholders.
	+ Design scalable and high\-performance SAP MDG solutions across multiple domains including:
		- Business Partner
		- Customer
		- Vendor/Supplier
		- Material
		- Finance
	+ Develop architecture blueprints, implementation roadmaps, and governance frameworks.
	+ Recommend best practices for master data governance, data quality, and data lifecycle management.
* **Customer Engagement**
	+ Act as a trusted advisor to customers and executive stakeholders.
	+ Lead customer discussions related to business requirements, solution design, delivery strategy, and roadmap planning.
	+ Present architecture solutions, estimations, risks, and technical recommendations.
	+ Support pre\-sales activities, RFP responses, solution demonstrations, and proposal development.
	+ Manage customer expectations and ensure successful project delivery.
* **SAP MDG Functional Leadership**
	+ Drive implementation and optimization of:
		- SAP MDG Central Governance
		- SAP MDG Consolidation
		- SAP MDG Mass Processing
		- SAP Data Quality Management
		- Data Replication Framework (DRF)
		- Workflow and Change Request Processes
	+ Define governance models, approval workflows, and business rules.
	+ Collaborate with business stakeholders to establish data stewardship and governance processes.
* **SAP MDG Technical Leadership**
	+ Architect and oversee technical implementations involving:
		- Data Models
		- Business Rules Framework Plus (BRF\+)
		- Workflow Configuration
		- UI Modeling
		- Data Replication Framework (DRF)
		- Enhancements and Custom Developments
	+ Review technical designs and ensure adherence to architecture standards.
	+ Guide teams on SAP MDG best practices and technical innovations.
* **Integration Architecture**
	+ Design and govern integrations between SAP MDG and enterprise applications using:
		- SOA Services
		- APIs
		- IDocs
		- Web Services
		- SAP PI/PO
		- SAP CPI/BTP Integration Suite
		- OData Services
	+ Ensure seamless master data synchronization across SAP and non\-SAP systems.
	+ Define integration patterns, monitoring strategies, and data replication mechanisms.
* **Team Leadership**
	+ Lead and mentor a team of approximately **15 SAP MDG consultants**, including functional, technical, integration, and data migration resources.
	+ Manage project planning, task allocation, quality reviews, and team development.
	+ Provide architectural governance and technical oversight throughout project lifecycles.
	+ Conduct solution reviews, code reviews, and design validations.
* **Delivery \& Governance**
	+ Ensure successful delivery of SAP MDG implementations, upgrades, and transformation programs.
	+ Identify project risks and provide mitigation strategies.
	+ Establish and enforce architecture standards, best practices, and governance processes.
	+ Support Agile and Waterfall project methodologies.

**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* **10\+ years of SAP experience** with significant experience in SAP Master Data Governance.
* Proven experience as a **Solution Architect or Lead Architect** in large\-scale SAP MDG transformation programs.
* Strong expertise in:
	+ SAP MDG Central Governance
	+ SAP MDG Consolidation
	+ SAP MDG Mass Processing
	+ SAP Data Quality Management
	+ Master Data Lifecycle Management
	+ Data Governance Frameworks
* Experience leading customer\-facing engagements and executive stakeholder interactions.
* Experience managing and mentoring teams of 10\-15\+ consultants.

**Technical Skills**


**SAP MDG**


* SAP MDG for Business Partner, Customer, Vendor, Material, and Finance
* Central Governance
* Consolidation
* Mass Processing
* Data Quality Management
* Data Replication Framework (DRF)
* BRF\+
* Workflow Management

**SAP Technologies**


* SAP S/4HANA
* SAP ECC
* SAP BTP
* SAP Fiori
* SAP Workflow
* ABAP (understanding of enhancements and custom developments)

**Integration Technologies**


* SOA Services
* REST APIs
* OData Services
* SAP CPI / Integration Suite
* SAP PI/PO
* IDocs
* Web Services

**Preferred Qualifications**


* SAP MDG Certification.
* SAP S/4HANA Certification.
* Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
* Experience in global master data transformation and governance programs.
* Knowledge of data migration and data quality tools.

**Key Competencies**


* Solution Architecture
* Executive Stakeholder Management
* Customer Relationship Management
* Strategic Consulting
* Team Leadership
* Problem Solving
* Enterprise Data Governance
* Communication \& Presentation Skills
* Delivery Management
* Pre\-Sales \& Solutioning

**Experience Required:** 10\+ Years
  

**Role Type:** Customer Facing / Leadership
  

**Team Size:** 15\+ Consultants
  

**Primary Focus:** SAP MDG Solution Architecture, Customer Engagement, Team Leadership, Central Governance, Consolidation, Mass Processing, Data Quality Management, and Enterprise Integration using SOA \& APIs.

  

At YASH, you are empowered to create a career that will take you to where you want to go while working in an inclusive team environment. We leverage career\-oriented skilling models and optimize our collective intelligence aided with technology for continuous learning, unlearning, and relearning at a rapid pace and scale.

  

**Our Hyperlearning workplace is grounded upon four principles**


* Flexible work arrangements, Free spirit, and emotional positivity
* Agile self\-determination, trust, transparency, and open collaboration
* All Support needed for the realization of business goals,
* Stable employment with a great atmosphere and ethical corporate culture

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Job Description  

Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI\-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore


We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.


We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.


Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM \+ AI conversation \- shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.

  

**What this role is**


* You will lead India Presales and a team of \~10\-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid\-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.  
* 

**What work looks like**


* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.

* Be a CXO\-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.

* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.

* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10\-15\-member organization; build capability and future leaders.

* Create a winning market motion. Define solution\-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.

* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.

* Build AI\-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI\-native.

* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time

**Role expectations**


* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.

* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.

* Raise the talent bar. Build a high\-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.

* Influence without waiting for authority. Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership to move strategic opportunities and market priorities forward.

* Have a point of view. Bring conviction on enterprise HCM trends, competitive dynamics, AI, and how customers will buy and operate differently in the future.

**What we’re looking for**


* 12–15\+ years of experience with significant enterprise presales / solution consulting leadership; proven ability to lead and scale presales teams.


* strong understanding of HCM and enterprise technology; exceptional executive presence and storytelling; strong deal strategy and cross\-functional influence; and a demonstrated ability to use AI and modern tooling to improve how presales operates.


**Why this role is different**


You won’t just help sell what Darwinbox has built. You’ll help shape how the market understands where enterprise HCM is going—and how Darwinbox, including Cortex, can lead that shift.

  

**About Darwinbox:**


Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.


Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

title: Senior Consultant
description:
**AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.**

**Position Title:** Senior Consultant, RTO

**Location:** Hyderabad, India

**Employment:** Full time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

**Main responsibilities**


RTO Candidate will be responsible for \-

* Managing day\-to\-day technical activities of the Real Time Optimisation (RTO) and Data Reconciliation \& Yield Accounting team for deliveries of projects to clients in domestic \& global locations in various Chemicals, Oil \& Gas (COG) viz. the Refinery \& Hydrocarbon industries and the Fossil fuel Power generation industries
* Working with its end clients and ensure quality \& timely deliveries to the assigned projects with full client satisfaction.
* Technical planning to deliver project demands based on local/regional forecasts
* Participating in pre\-sales activities (Validation of manhour estimates, proposals review etc.) as and when required.
* Meeting company defined KPI’s applicable to the team.

 **Essential skills and experience required**

* Candidates should have strong chemical Engineering fundamentals.
* Should have total of 8\+ years of experience out of which he/she should have hands on experience on Steady state \&/or dynamic simulations for at least 3\+ years.
* For remaining experience, Hydrocarbon plant operations experience will be considered relevant.
* Proficiency in implementation of simulations Models (using commercial RTO software i.e., ROMeo, etc.), Yield accounting, APC will be preferred,
* Good problem solving, communication, interpersonal and team playing skills

 **Qualification:**

* B Tech/M Tech Chemical Engineering as a minimum.

**Services at AVEVA**


Our dynamic global team of 700\+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting\-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.


You’ll also be joining an award\-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.


Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

 **India Benefits include:**


Gratuity, Medical and accidental insurance, very attractive leave entitlement, emergency leave days, childcare support, maternity, paternity and adoption leaves, education assistance program, home office set up support (for hybrid roles), well\-being support


It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

  

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

 **Hybrid working**


We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on\-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office\-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

 **Hiring process**


Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.
